resville 9.8.327
Meine Liebes! Es eilt zwar alles, ich
will aber nicht versäumen, dir einige
Zeilen mitzusenden. Die Reise geht

zu werden. Am schwersten ist
mir immer wieder, dass ich durch
diesen Umstand so lange auf einer
Antwort von Dir warten

An Baba
translated_text: Resville, August 9, 1932. My dearest! Everything is in a hurry, but I don't want to miss the opportunity to send you a few lines. Unfortunately, the journey is progressing far too slowly for me, and in my impatient mood, I'm not giving up trying to be patient. What I find hardest is that this situation means I have to wait so long for a reply from you. But the day will pass, and I hope to find lots of mail from my Babs in my hands. We're now driving along the beautiful Rhine, and it's absolutely wonderful. Nature is at least a welcome respite from all the business. It's the only thing that makes this trip a little less difficult for me and allows me to still work with some ambition and joy. To be honest, it's not quite as bad as I thought it would be. The fact that things are moving so slowly doesn't change the fact that I'll soon be back home with Baba. Your Bob 304 To Baba
